stories.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Rubio condemns deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, says US stands with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio strongly condemned a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh that killed 12 people, including an American citizen, and stated that the United States supports Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Coalition Forces vow firm response over Riyadh airport strike, Trump says Houthi attack ‘not acceptable’

en.title: Coalition Forces vow firm response over Riyadh airport strike, Trump says Houthi attack 'not acceptable'
en.summary: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen pledged a firm response to a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport that killed 12 and injured 309, while US President Trump called the strike unacceptable and coalition officials characterized it as a war crime.

stories.title: International outcry grows after deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport

en.title: International outcry grows after deadly Houthi attack on Riyadh airport
en.summary: Global leaders and the UN Secretary-General have condemned a Houthi missile strike on Riyadh airport that caused 12 deaths and over 300 injuries, calling for increased protection of civilians and aviation infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Coalition vows firm response to Houthi war crime at Riyadh airport

en.title: Coalition vows firm response to Houthi war crime at Riyadh airport
en.summary: The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen characterized a Houthi attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh as a war crime and vowed a firm response in accordance with international humanitarian law.

stories.title: Projectile lands near King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, coalition says

en.title: Projectile lands near King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, coalition says
en.summary: A projectile landed near King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, according to the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen. The incident occurs as Saudi Arabia experiences multiple attacks on aviation facilities.

stories.title: 12 killed, 309 injured in attack on Riyadh airport, GACA confirms

en.title: 12 killed, 309 injured in attack on Riyadh airport, GACA confirms
en.summary: An attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh resulted in 12 deaths and 309 injuries, with victims from multiple countries. All injured individuals are receiving medical treatment at hospitals.

stories.title: Trump ‘looking at’ airstrikes against Houthis after Riyadh airport attacks

en.title: Trump 'looking at' airstrikes against Houthis after Riyadh airport attacks
en.summary: President Trump indicated the United States may rapidly decide to participate in airstrikes against the Houthi militia in Yemen following a fourth attack on Riyadh airport within a week, which resulted in casualties and injuries.

en.title: Riyadh airport suspends operations after new attack leaves several injured
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's aviation authority temporarily suspended operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh after an attack on Saturday injured several people amid ongoing strikes against civil aviation facilities.
